- No `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash` style pipelines, exfiltration, or obfuscation exists at the top level.
- The `package()` function is not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` (function bodies only run later), and even its contents — installing the binary, gzipping the man page, and installing license/doc files into `${pkgdir}` — are standard, legitimate packaging behavior.

Nothing in the sourced code downloads, executes, or exfiltrates untrusted data. This is ordinary packaging for a distribution of a prebuilt binary.
